notes.title: Just Released on Steam, Atonement 2: Ruptured by Despair
notes.content:
The brand new Atonement 2: Ruptured by despair has just been released! For those of you who loved the first game, here comes the sequel, with even more great gameplay, story and characters! 

The last king was killed over 400 years ago and the global rule of the land ceased to exist. The Vindicator is coming. ~a decadent, dark fantasy world with a new take on the concepts of Angels and Demons! 
Click the link below if your interested then hurry, buy the game with a 30% launch discount and whittle hours completing it! 
http://store.steampowered.com/app/533820/?snr=1_5_1100__1100

If you haven't tried the first game and this sounds like your cup of tea, go check it out on the following link! 
http://store.steampowered.com/app/385070/?snr=1_5_1100__1100

notes.title: Check Out Radical Spectrum, A retro style arcade game!
notes.content:
Radical Spectrum is a classically-inspired arcade game with infinitely increasing speed and difficulty. 
Featuring a unique colour-collecting mechanic that adds a light puzzle element. 
This game is a great time killer and you're sure to have a fun and challenging experience whilst playing, 
Engaging the mind as well as entertaining it! 
http://store.steampowered.com/app/486150/?snr=1_5_1100__1100

notes.title: Controller Support Added
notes.content: Controllers are now supported in Dungeon of Zolthan.  After connecting your controller and starting the game, use your keyboard to go to the controls option and then select "controller setup".  Press a button at each prompt to set each control.  After that you can play the game fully with your controller and not need the keyboard.

notes.title: First Update
notes.content:
I made an update to the game, and here is the list of changes.

[list]
    [*]Double tapping left/right to dash can now be toggled on or off.  It defaults to ON for previous players and OFF for new players.
    [*]A Mac version has been added.
    [*]The text for the dash powerup now mentions the dash key set in the control settings.
    [*]Invulnerability time has been reduced for all enemies, including bosses.
    [*]The first boss has 2 less health, a slightly lower starting speed, but a much higher max speed.
    [*]A save point has been added near the first powerup.
    [*]The main music loop has been extended and the final boss music has been changed.
[/list]
